title_en: People are the focus. 44th Division of Army, all agencies to work together on Sai Buri dam emergency plan with maximum safety in mind.
summary_en: On November 16, 2569, Major General Natthawutsiri Srisangk, Commander of the Special Task Force at the 44th Ranger Division, attended a meeting to discuss how to resolve the problem of dam collapse along Sai Buri River in Thalubang City Council, Sai Buri District, Pattani Province.
